messages:
ashley_support: Customer reported 400 on /invoke when calling the payments tool. says: "Schema validation failed: additionalProperties ("isActive") not allowed and required field "billing_profile.id" missing"
ashley_support: they pasted the payload from their SDK, looks like client sent isActive: true (boolean) and billing_profile omitted entirely
customer-case-bot: Case #62441 attached logs and original request (redacted). Customer notes it worked until yesterday after SDK update v1.7.4 -> v1.8.0 :confused:
devin_engineer: can you paste the exact payload?
ashley_support: pasted below:
```
{
  "tool": "payments.createInvoice",
  "args": {
    "amount": "1200",
    "currency": "USD",
    "isActive": true,
    "line_items": [{"desc": "setup", "qty": 1, "price": "1200"}]
  },
  "metadata": {"requester": "acme-corp"}
}
```
kouki_sre: Gateway validator returned:
```
HTTP 400 Bad Request
{
  "errors": [
    {"path": "/args/billing_profile", "message": "required property 'billing_profile' is missing"},
    {"path": "/args/isActive", "message": "additional properties not allowed: isActive"}
  ]
}
```
devin_engineer: interesting — older SDK used to send isActive as "true" string and included an empty billing_profile object by default. v1.8.0 removed that shim.
ashley_support: customer says they didn't change anything other than upgrading SDK via package manager, so they hit this when we tightened validation in runtime earlier this week
devin_engineer: likely two issues: (1) breaking change in validator: now rejects extra props, and (2) SDK stopped auto-including billing_profile. We should reproduce locally.
kouki_sre: repro steps I used:
1) curl to /invoke with payload above -> 400
2) alter payload: add "billing_profile": {"id": "tmp-123"} -> passes schema check but downstream billing errors (weird)
3) coerce isActive to "true" -> passes schema check if billing_profile exists
devin_engineer: can we change validator to allow additionalProperties for this tool for a short period and log occurrences? or better: coerce boolean->string for fields declared as string
kouki_sre: we have a feature flag for lenient-schema-shim on gateway. we can enable for payments.* route. will generate metric and revert in 48h.
ashley_support: good plan. what's the risk?
devin_engineer: low; we only allow permissive validation for this tool, still enforce required fields. must also inform docs/SDK teams to ship patch.
deploy-bot: @devin_engineer requested feature-flag toggle for lenient-schema-shim on route payments.createInvoice. Canary rollout scheduled: canary 10% -> 30m -> 100% if no regression.
kouki_sre: toggled canary on at 1713142800, monitoring for errors and anomalous latency
devin_engineer: created SDK hotfix branch to re-add billing_profile defaulting and coerce isActive to string; will PR today. CC @ashley_support for customer comms
ashley_support: I'll reply to the case with a reproducible workaround: downgrade to SDK 1.7.4 or add billing_profile.id and send isActive as string. ETA to customer: temporary workaround now, patch tomorrow.
ashley_support: sample workaround payload to share with customer:
```
{
  "tool": "payments.createInvoice",
  "args": {
    "amount": "1200",
    "currency": "USD",
    "isActive": "true",
    "billing_profile": {"id": "tmp-123"},
    "line_items": [{"desc": "setup", "qty": 1, "price": "1200"}]
  }
}
```
kouki_sre: alert: no increased error rate in canary, latency stable
devin_engineer: will merge SDK shim once tests pass, plan to remove lenient flag after SDK patch adoption window (48h). file a follow-up to ensure we don't leave flag on.
ashley_support: thanks all — I'll update the ticket and set a calendar reminder to verify flag off in 72h. closing thread once customer confirms resolution :+1:
